[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Kanjil Mang''' was a female [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]].

==Biography==
[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Kanjil Mang was an [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] working out of the [[University of Tibrin]]. She specialized in studying alien cultures, focusing on smaller societies. One of her studies, examining transplanted primitive enclave societies in industrial settings, led her to study the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] tribes on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

Over the course of a year, Mang's studies allowed her to become an honorary member of both the [[Irden]] and [[Botrut]] tribes. She is familiar with the Ugnaught warrens throughout the [[Mining Quarter]] and is an expert on the subject of Ugnaught culture and art.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Personality and traits==
Mang was a short, even-tempered and calm Ishi Tib who spoke with a soft guttural voice and a habit of speaking with her flukes.<ref name="GG2-2" />

Spending a lot of time in the dry areas of the Mining Quarter was rough on the Ishi Tib skin, causing Mang to spend several hours in the more humid environment of Cloud City's upper tourist levels drinking and bathing.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Equipment==
Mang carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and owned a [[Secretary droid/Legends|secretary droid]].<ref name="GG2-2" />
